criteria.reasoning: D1 shows "Target: 120 unique learners", "Actual: 131 learners" and "Status: Met."

D2 is "Status: Not Met", with the target measured against actual enrollment: "With 131 enrolled learners, the target is 98.25" against an actual of 94. The memo also rejects Marcus's use of the 120 goal. It does not print 71.8%, but the not-met finding rests on the required 131 denominator.
D3 is "Status: Met" against a target of 60% of the 94 completers (56.4), with 61 actual. The memo explicitly rejects the 73 post-tested denominator. It does not state 83.6% as the result.
D4 shows "Target: 25", "Actual: 26" and "Status: Met." The memo does not count 27 tutors as trained.
D5 is "Status: Not Met" because meetings were held only in Q1–Q3. The memo says "a July 16 meeting falls outside the Year 1 grant period" and rejects Marcus's claim that it "still counts for Q4."

The memo identifies "a $640 charge for beer and wine service on May 29, 2026 (AP-2242)" as unallowable and says it "must be removed from the grant's accounts and paid from unrestricted funds." The variance table and totals exclude it.
The table shows Learner supports at $12,000 budget, $13,560 actual, "+$1,560", "+13.0%", Approval Required "Yes". The text says it exceeds the 10% threshold and requires prior written approval.
The table shows Curriculum & materials at $8,000 budget, $6,920 actual, "-$1,080", "-13.5%", Approval Required "Yes". The text says it exceeds the 10% threshold and needs approval.
Every other line (Personnel, Fringe, Tutor training, Local travel, Evaluation consultant) is marked "No" in the Approval Required column. Only Learner supports and Curriculum are flagged.

The table gives Personnel $66,980 / -$1,020 / -1.5%, Fringe $13,396 / -$204 / -1.5%, Tutor training $4,700 / -$300 / -6.0%, Local travel $3,310 / -$290 / -8.1% and Evaluation consultant $9,800 / $0 / 0.0%. All match the required figures.
The memo reports "Total Allowable Expenditures: $118,666.00 (Ledger total of $119,306.00 minus the $640 unallowable alcohol charge)" and "Unspent Funds: $1,334.00", which "carry forward to Year 2."
The calendar lists "Interim Report Due: August 14, 2026 (45 days after the end of Year 1)."
The calendar lists "No-Cost Extension Request Deadline (if needed): April 1, 2027 (90 days before the end of the grant period)."

The memo gives "Final Report Due: September 28, 2027" but never says unspent grant funds are returned with the final report. Its only treatment of unspent funds is that they "carry forward to Year 2 ... and must be reported in the interim report." The criterion fails when the return of unspent funds is omitted.
